value.rationale: A genuinely motivated optimal-sampling invariant for the simplest dissipative oscillatory semigroup is solved for all damping ratios and all positive delays, including infinitely many competing phase aliases. Global uniqueness, strict pre-perpendicular timing, orientation independence, and sharp strong-damping asymptotics supply actionable exact design information beyond standard rank/determinant checks.
